remarks: BACK ON THE MARKET! NEW UPDATES: Newly full renovated 2nd floor bathroom and primary suite flooring! Haig Avenue is a unique oasis with all the comforts of home! This is a must-see to get a full view of all the features and amenities. Enjoy entertaining with the open floor plan kitchen and family room- including built in bar. Step outside to the back patio and enjoy the built in grill while listening to the waterfall of your personal koi pond. Take a swim in your in-ground gunite pool or tend to your raised bed garden. Meticulous care of this home really shows with the beautifully landscaped setting. The interior of this home has been updated with fresh paint throughout a brand new kitchen (2025) and new central a/c units (2019 and 2025). 2nd story with 3 generously sized bedrooms and office space makes up the main personal areas. 3rd story is dedicated to the primary suite for privacy and space. Lower level with laundry is a great space for a play or rec room. Schedule your private showing to experience all this home has to offer!
